_comment: One page per problem on Kazma's machine (unified alerts, Stage 2): who pages a key's condition instead of its sender. kazma_core.observability.alert_catalog.inside_hold and the guard's stdlib copy (kazma_guard._inside_hold) must both answer 'want' ("" = the sender pages it). receipts: both inside senders' open page receipts; speaks: which senders can page now.

cases.name: a non-owner records while the owner (Kazma Watch) watches
a non-owner pages when no owner can speak
a shared owner records when the other paged and it reached someone
a page that reached nobody holds nothing back
the guard's database service page waits for Kazma's
the boot wait page waits for the guard's own service page
a sender's own earlier page of the same key is its cooldown's, not a hold
a page with no condition is always sent
a sole owner pages its own condition
a key not in the catalog pages
a filled key without a condition pages
